title: THE SHOP GREYS WHAT YOU CANNOT AFFORD
why: From the 4K screenshot pass of 2026-10-09: in the shop every price was the same amber, so a 2,340 item looked as buyable as a 300 one with 900 credits in hand. A price you cannot pay now reads grey, so the shop says at a glance what you can buy.
now: The shop shows prices you cannot afford in grey.

edits.replacement: cell.className='vcell'+(i===P._shopSel?' on':'')+(locked?' locked':'')+((o.price>(P.credits||0))?' poor':'');   // v16.xx: a price you cannot pay reads grey
